name: @educateos/provider-fakes
description: Wire-faithful fakes of the providers EducateOS integrates with, built from their published API documentation: OIDC identity providers (Clever, ClassLink, Google), the Clever Data API v3.1, OneRoster 1.2 REST (the ClassLink OAuth2 profile), the Google Classroom API and Canvas- and Schoology-flavoured LTI 1.3 platforms. Each is a fetch handler over caller-supplied synthetic seed data, with fault injection. A library, not a deployable Worker.
